_comment: Demo-only consumer wording. Keys are API message codes (api/messages) or demo chrome codes. A key 'CODE.go_now' is used instead of 'CODE' when the advice is to go now. Numbers in params are rounded to whole units before rendering. No contractions.
BEST_WINDOW: This is your best window today.
WORSE_LATER: After that, conditions turn against you.
HEAT_RISES: {wbgt_c} °C heat stress in your window, {peak_wbgt_c} °C at {peak_time}. Above {indoor_line_c} °C we suggest training indoors.
HEAT_RISES.go_now: {wbgt_c} °C heat stress now, {peak_wbgt_c} °C at {peak_time}. Above {indoor_line_c} °C we suggest training indoors.
AIR_CLEAN: The air stays clean all day.
AIR_PEAK_LATER: {pollutant} rises to {peak_ugm3} µg/m³ by {peak_time}. It is {window_ugm3} in your window.
AIR_PM_EPISODE: Smoke and dust peak at {peak_ugm3} µg/m³ at {peak_time}. It is {window_ugm3} in your window.
POLLEN_PEAK_AVOIDED: Pollen peaks at {peak} grains/m³. Your window stays below 50.
POLLEN_HIGH_IN_WINDOW: Pollen is high even in your window ({window} grains/m³).
POLLEN_NOT_COVERED: No pollen forecast for this area.
COLD_WARM_UP: Wind chill {wind_chill_c} °C into the wind. Warm up indoors and keep the first kilometre easy.
WIND_START_INTO: {wind_word} {from} wind. Start into it, and it is behind you on the way home.
WIND_LIGHT: Light wind, so any direction works.
ATHLETE_NOT_ADAPTED: Not used to heat yet, {mass_kg} kg, {height_cm} cm, {clothing_word}.
TIMELINE_ARIA: Your window {start} to {end}, on a timeline from now ({now}) to {day_end}
CREDITS: Weather and air: Open-Meteo / ERA5 (CC BY 4.0) · Map © OpenStreetMap contributors
CREDITS_DATA: Weather and air: Open-Meteo / ERA5 (CC BY 4.0)
ONB_INTRO: So your advice fits you, not an average runner.
ONB_HEAT: Are you used to running in heat?
ONB_CONSENT: Your answers stay on this phone and only shape your advice.
TOMORROW.GO_AT_SHORT: Tomorrow: run at {start}, keep it short
TOMORROW_BODY_air: The air gets worse after that.
TOMORROW_BODY_cold: It is bitterly cold before that.
TOMORROW_BODY_indoor: Too hot for a safe run outside all day.
NO_MESSAGE: No message tonight: tomorrow suits the usual run, so GOTime stays quiet.
GLANCE_RING_ARIA: Your window {start} to {end} on a 12-hour dial
ROUTE_LOOP: {name} loop, {loop_km} km. {laps_word} laps fit your {minutes} minutes
ROUTE_LOOP_ONE: {name} loop, {loop_km} km. One lap fits your {minutes} minutes
ROUTE_AIR: Cleaner air than {compared_with}: {saving_pct}% less traffic pollution
AFTER_SUB_AIR: You missed the worst of the air.
AFTER_FEEL: Compared with your usual run, it felt…
FEEL_THANKS: Thanks. This tunes your next advice.
ROUTE_LOOP_SHORT: {name} loop, {loop_km} km. Turn back halfway to keep to {minutes} minutes
AFTER_WATER_NONE: You sweated about {ml} ml, no need to top up.
AFTER_WATER_NONE_CMP: You sweated about {ml} ml, no need to top up. At {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK_CMP: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour. At {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK_LOCAL: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour: {drink}.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK_CMP_LOCAL: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour: {drink}. At {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
SKIP_USUAL_SMOKE: Skip your usual {time} run today: smoke.
SKIP_USUAL_AIR: Skip your usual {time} run today: the air is poor.
SKIP_USUAL_HEAT: Skip your usual {time} run today: too hot.
SKIP_USUAL_SMOKE_TOMORROW: Skip your usual {time} run: thick smoke at that hour.
SKIP_USUAL_AIR_TOMORROW: Skip your usual {time} run: poor air at that hour.
SKIP_USUAL_HEAT_TOMORROW: Skip your usual {time} run: too hot at that hour.
ROUTE_OUTBACK_ONE: {name}, {leg_km} km each way. There and back once fits your {minutes} minutes
ROUTE_OUTBACK: {name}, {leg_km} km each way. {trips_word} times there and back fit your {minutes} minutes
ROUTE_OUTBACK_SHORT: {name}, {leg_km} km each way. Turn back after {turn_km} km to keep to {minutes} minutes
_note_reference: CF_* keys: counterfactuals against the day's one reference hour (engine/reference.ts). USUAL = the runner's usual start time, WORST = worst hour of the top factor.
CF_WHY_HEAT_USUAL: At your usual {time}, heat stress would be {delta_c} °C higher.
CF_WHY_HEAT_WORST: You miss the hottest part of the day. At {time}, heat stress is {delta_c} °C higher.
CF_WHY_SMOKE_USUAL: At your usual {time}, PM2.5 would be about {ref_ugm3} µg/m³. In your window it is {ran_ugm3}.
CF_WHY_SMOKE_WORST: You skip the smoke. At {time}, PM2.5 is {ref_ugm3} µg/m³; in your window it is {ran_ugm3}.
CF_WHY_AIR_USUAL: At your usual {time}, {pollutant} would be about {ref_ugm3} µg/m³. In your window it is {ran_ugm3}.
CF_WHY_AIR_WORST: You miss the worst of the air. At {time}, {pollutant} is {ref_ugm3} µg/m³; in your window it is {ran_ugm3}.
CF_AFTER_HEAT_USUAL: At your usual {time}, heat stress would have been {delta_c} °C higher.
CF_AFTER_HEAT_WORST: At {time}, heat stress would have been {delta_c} °C higher.
CF_AFTER_SMOKE_USUAL: At your usual {time}, PM2.5 would have been about {ref_ugm3} µg/m³. In your window it was {ran_ugm3}.
CF_AFTER_SMOKE_WORST: At {time}, smoke and dust would have been {ref_ugm3} µg/m³; on your run it was {ran_ugm3}.
CF_AFTER_AIR_USUAL: At your usual {time}, {pollutant} would have been about {ref_ugm3} µg/m³. In your window it was {ran_ugm3}.
CF_AFTER_AIR_WORST: At {time}, {pollutant} would have been {ref_ugm3} µg/m³; on your run it was {ran_ugm3}.
CF_EVENING_HEAT_USUAL: At your usual {time}, heat stress will be {delta_c} °C higher.
CF_EVENING_SMOKE_USUAL: At your usual {time}, PM2.5 will be about {ref_ugm3} µg/m³.
CF_EVENING_AIR_USUAL: At your usual {time}, {pollutant} will be about {ref_ugm3} µg/m³.
AFTER_INDOOR_HEAT_USUAL: At your usual {time}, heat stress outside would have been {ref_c} °C.
AFTER_INDOOR_HEAT_WORST: Outside, heat stress peaked at {ref_c} °C at {time}.
AFTER_INDOOR_SMOKE_USUAL: At your usual {time}, PM2.5 outside would have been about {ref_ugm3} µg/m³.
AFTER_INDOOR_SMOKE_WORST: Outside, PM2.5 peaked at {ref_ugm3} µg/m³ at {time}.
AFTER_INDOOR_AIR_USUAL: At your usual {time}, {pollutant} outside would have been about {ref_ugm3} µg/m³.
AFTER_SUB_AIR_USUAL: Cleaner air than your usual {time} run.
AFTER_WATER_NONE_CMP_USUAL: You sweated about {ml} ml, no need to top up. At your usual {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK_CMP_USUAL: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour. At your usual {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
AFTER_WATER_DRINK_CMP_USUAL_LOCAL: You sweated about {ml} ml, so drink about that much in the next hour: {drink}. At your usual {time} it would have been about {worst_ml} ml.
NUMBERS_INTRO: Hour by hour, from now. Your window is marked.
WEEK_HEADLINE: {good} of {total} runs in your best window
WEEK_AVOIDED_AIR: Smoke or poor air avoided on {n}.
WEEK_STREAK: Streak: {n} well-timed runs. Indoor sessions count.
WEEK_NEXT: Next week: we message you the evening before, only if your usual time does not fit.
WEEK_STREAK_ONE: Streak: 1 well-timed run. Indoor sessions count.
ROUTE_START_vondelpark_b: Start at the Van Baerlestraat end
UT_Q_today_when: When will you run, and why?
UT_Q_comprehension: Facilitator: could they explain the reason in their own words?
UT_Q_why_top: Which reason matters most to you?
UT_Q_why_doubt: Is there anything you do not believe?
UT_Q_after_feel: How does this card make you feel about your decision?
UT_Q_useful: How useful is this for you?
UT_Q_trust: How much do you trust the advice?
UT_CONSENT_ASK: We show you a running app for a made-up day and ask what you would do, and a few ratings. It takes 10 to 15 minutes.
UT_CONSENT_STORE: Your answers stay on this phone. We do not ask for your name.
UT_CONSENT_EXPORT: Afterwards the facilitator exports the answers from this phone, without names, for the research.
UT_CONSENT_STOP: You can stop at any time, without giving a reason.
TIP_COLD_HARD_INDOORS: Below −15 °C: do the hard session indoors today.
TIP_HEAT_NOT_ADAPTED: Not used to heat yet: keep it easy and a bit shorter. In about a week your body copes better.
TIP_PRECOOL: A cool shower just before you go makes the first kilometres easier.
TIP_HYDRATE_EVENING: Hot tomorrow: drink normally tonight and have a glass of water before you go.
TIP_RUN_BY_FEEL: Muggy today: run by feel. Your watch pace will be slower, and that is fine.
TIP_COLD_WARMUP: Freezing today: warm up 10 minutes indoors, start slowly, buff over your mouth.
